items.question: Do you come out to Henderson, or do I come to you?
items.answer: Vehicles come to our Boulder City shop for tint, chip repair and windshield work. For homes and offices in Henderson, we come to you to measure and install.

items.question: Do you arrange windshield replacement for Henderson drivers?
items.answer: Yes, it is arranged through us. We do not keep windshields in stock, so the glass is ordered to your VIN and the job is booked once it arrives. Chip repair we do in our own shop; the replacement itself is done by a glass specialist we work with, and we help with the order, the booking and the insurance claim.

items.question: Is the tint you install legal in Nevada?
items.answer: Yes. Film on your front side windows has to let through not less than 35 percent of light, with a 7 percent tolerance, counting the glass and the film together, and it has to be nonreflective. The windshield can only carry a strip across the very top. See Nevada tint law. Source: Nevada Revised Statutes 484D.440.

items.question: Can you do a whole house, or a new build?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us roughly how many windows and we measure and give you a free quote before any work starts. Most jobs are finished on site in a single visit.
